services.desc: We provide affordability and easy accessibility to rentals from our Kaysville location. The best part is that we are located right next to the highway and are en route to all of the area’s lakes. Bear Lake is the perfect destination for riding. Blue Wave Jet Ski Rentals is currently renting the NEW Yamaha VX Sport. Comfortably able to hold 3 riders at a time, our NEW Yamaha VX Sport is the perfect jet ski for fun in the sun.
